authority.integrity_rule: Any disagreement among the five files fails closed.

global_declaration_contract.construction: Exact keyword-only fields; no defaults, positional arguments, unknown fields, subclasses, null, or Python float.
global_declaration_contract.projection: Deterministic to_ecj1 over every field except envelope; object_content_payload must match byte-logically.
global_declaration_contract.identity: Reuse CommonObjectEnvelope, object-content hash, ECJ-1, SemanticVersion, lifecycle, and supersession unchanged.
global_declaration_contract.object_references: Opaque exact triples; local kind syntax is compatibility only; target meaning needs directly supplied companion or external fail-closed acceptance.
global_declaration_contract.collections: Every tuple collection is duplicate-free. CANONICAL_REF orders ObjectRef triples; key collections use declared recursive keys; SEMANTIC_SEQUENCE preserves order after duplicate rejection; subsets order by cardinality then lexicographic ref key with empty first.
global_declaration_contract.numbers: Exact CoreNumberV1 only; no binary approximation or implicit conversion.
global_declaration_contract.units: Equal unit, dimension, boundary, sign, and time coordinates precede arithmetic; explicit conversion only.
global_declaration_contract.claims: Declaration-specific ClaimStatus and required closed nonclaims; no empirical, causal, endorsement, or execution inference.
global_declaration_contract.immutability: All fields immutable; prospective does not mean runtime-fillable.
global_declaration_contract.runtime: Only construction, projection, and named local T0 validation.
global_declaration_contract.validator_bypass: No owning-validator call means no accepted declaration.

new_failures.name: EXTENT_DECLARATION_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: Extent family, coordinate, bounds, orientation, domain, topology, carrier/bundle, clock/order, path/process, or reversible-flow applicability is inconsistent.

new_failures.name: EXTENT_DIVISIBILITY_UNDECLARED
new_failures.meaning: Refinement or generator semantics are asserted without a compatible explicit divisibility declaration for the extent.

new_failures.name: ATOMIC_REFINEMENT_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: The refinement does not preserve T0 identity and the finite transaction, or its derivative existence/nonexistence arms are inconsistent.

new_failures.name: GENERATOR_DECLARATION_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: A quantity-participation or state-transformation generator has inconsistent coordinate, codomain, orientation, domain, topology, sign, or account semantics.

new_failures.name: GENERATOR_LINK_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: The constitutive/incidence link does not connect compatible quantity and state generators over the same extent, boundary, units, and coordinates.

new_failures.name: AUGMENTED_STATE_INCOMPLETE
new_failures.meaning: A state generator omits a represented stock, conversion, loss, burden, commitment, queue, transit, delayed-effect, mode, topology, clock, or policy-memory role without explicitly declaring it inapplicable.

new_failures.name: REPARAMETERIZATION_WITNESS_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: The declared parameter map, inverse/applicability, derivative scale, regularity, orientation, transformed generator, density/limit transformation, or integrated-change claim is inconsistent.

new_failures.name: HYBRID_ACTIVATION_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: Off, minimum-active, maximum-active, transition, mode, jump/flow order, commitment, or fixed-burden semantics are inconsistent.

new_failures.name: FIXED_ACTIVATION_ACCOUNT_DUPLICATED
new_failures.meaning: The same fixed activation burden is represented more than once across its fixed-cost account and process accounts.

new_failures.name: RECONSTRUCTION_CLAIM_UNSUPPORTED
new_failures.meaning: The finite reconstruction kind, T0 identity, existence, uniqueness, regularity, ordered evolution, hybrid activation, domain, or remainder support is insufficient for the stated claim.

new_failures.name: BOUNDARY_HISTORY_EQUIVALENCE_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: The witness asserts history-wide boundary equivalence without all admitted histories, compatible initial states/evolution, or while relying only on snapshot or one-state generator equality.

new_failures.name: BOUNDARY_ACCOUNT_PRESERVATION_INCOMPLETE
new_failures.meaning: Burden, conservation, loss, commitment, applicable settlement, process-account, hidden-state, or exported internal-topology preservation is incomplete.

new_failures.name: FORBIDDEN_DECLARATION_RUNTIME_BEHAVIOR
new_failures.meaning: Declaration code exposes or embeds behavior beyond deterministic construction, projection, and local T0 validation.

new_failures.name: VALIDATOR_BYPASS_FORBIDDEN
new_failures.meaning: Construction without the owning validator has no accepted declaration result.

new_failures.name: OBJECTIVE_GRAMMAR_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: Scalar/vector objective arms, feasibility-first rule, units, selection rule, epsilon constraints, direction, assumptions, or deterministic tie rule are inconsistent.

new_failures.name: SUBSET_PROTOCOL_INCOMPLETE
new_failures.meaning: A required frozen subset coordinate or complete nonoverlapping account is absent.

new_failures.name: SUBSET_LATTICE_INCOMPLETE
new_failures.meaning: Every Boolean subset including empty is not present exactly once in cardinality-lexicographic order.

new_failures.name: MOBIUS_CLOSURE_FAILURE
new_failures.meaning: Exact Möbius coefficient or inverse reconstruction arithmetic fails.

new_failures.name: TRUNCATION_RESIDUAL_MISMATCH
new_failures.meaning: An exact truncation reconstruction omits, misorders, mis-signs, or misstates its explicit residual.

new_failures.name: COMPARATOR_INTERACTION_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: Same-baseline or serial-comparator interaction values do not close exactly under the frozen common boundary, state, horizon, accounts, and comparison protocol.

new_failures.name: MIXED_MARGINAL_WITNESS_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: The complete rectangle, increments, units, regularity arm, finite difference, normalized mixed marginal, topology, tolerance, or sign convention is inconsistent.

new_failures.name: COMMUTATOR_WITNESS_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: The ordered compositions, bracket, order difference, remainder, extent, domain, topology, modes, orientation, or regularity evidence is inconsistent.

new_failures.name: COMMUTATIVITY_SCOPE_OVERCLAIM
new_failures.meaning: A zero commutator at one state is promoted to neighbourhood commutativity without the required neighbourhood witness.

new_failures.name: SHARED_CONSTRAINT_OWNERSHIP_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: A shared factor lacks coherent kind, participating actions, constraint, timing, hierarchy, owner, lowest common boundary, distributed protocol, or authority.

new_failures.name: SHARED_BOUNDARY_VISIBILITY_MISSING
new_failures.meaning: The owning or factor boundary cannot see all demand, state, or binding information required to represent the shared constraint.

new_failures.name: INTERACTION_TOPOLOGY_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: Structural/active hyperedges, typed interaction references, factor nodes, action membership, boundary, state, horizon, or subset protocol are inconsistent.

new_failures.name: HIDDEN_STATE_TOPOLOGY_UNRESOLVED
new_failures.meaning: A topology or factor claim depends on hidden state whose resolution is neither explicit nor fail-closed unresolved.

new_failures.name: BOUNDARY_INTERACTION_PRESERVATION_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: A claimed preserved exposed interaction lacks complete subset, coefficient, account, hidden-state, or history-wide boundary evidence.

new_failures.name: ALLOCATION_FEASIBILITY_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: The proposed allocation violates feasibility-first constraints, boundary/horizon/action scope, or objective compatibility.

new_failures.name: OPTIMALITY_CERTIFICATE_INAPPLICABLE
new_failures.meaning: The certificate kind or KKT claim is incompatible with the declared discrete, nonsmooth, nonconvex, vector, or regularity conditions.

new_failures.name: SCALAR_DECOMPOSITION_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: The selected scalar total, baseline, shares, interaction terms, and explicit residual do not satisfy the declared exact closure rule.

new_failures.name: DECOMPOSITION_PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE
new_failures.meaning: A scalar decomposition lacks its declared path, ordering, protocol, action, interaction, objective, or source-witness provenance.

new_failures.name: INSTITUTIONAL_RULE_INVALID
new_failures.meaning: An acceptance or settlement rule lacks immutable authority, policy, version, effective interval, deterministic procedure, eligibility, precedence, or provenance.

new_failures.name: CAUSAL_SETTLEMENT_CONFLATION
new_failures.meaning: A nonidentified institutional share is causally relabelled or a causal rule lacks identified status.

new_failures.name: SETTLEMENT_RESIDUAL_CLOSURE_MISSING
new_failures.meaning: Explicit measured-total equals share-total plus residual closure and immutable physical history are not required.

new_failures.name: PROHIBITED_INTERFERENCE_CLAIM
